- Analytical and solution-oriented mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse international stakeholders.
- Self-driven, detail-oriented, and resilient team player with fluent German and English skills, both written and spoken.
- Willingness to travel up to 30% and to provide on-site support during project commissioning when required.

- Bring in your ideas and proposal to shape the success of Process Engineer Logistics and Packaging at Exyte.
